context.title: Add field guide for platform engineers moving to inference
context.body:
Add "From Platform Engineer to Inference Engineer: An Open Field
Guide to Inference Engineering", a guide for platform engineers
moving into inference work.

- [x] Read and followed Modelplane's contribution process.
- [x] ~~Run `nix flake check` (or `./nix.sh flake check`) and made sure it passes.~~
- [x] ~~Added or updated tests covering any composition function changes.~~
- [x] Signed off every commit with `git commit -s`.

Signed-off-by: Annie Talvasto <Annie.talvasto@gmail.com>

commits.messageHeadline: docs: add Platform Engineer to Inference Engineer field guide
commits.messageBody:
Add "From Platform Engineer to Inference Engineer: An Open Field
